title: Damaged Product (Times 3)
text: Damaged Product (Times 3). I ordered three of these at one time. All three--yes all three--had damaged wood inside the boxes. Bent wood. Chipped wood. Peeled wood. Damaged corners. Damaged edges. My gosh...all three! And multiple damaged pieces in all three boxes. These cabinets are some of the most awfully packed cabinets I have ever encountered. Do not buy these unless they are going into a garage, where you won't care that the wood pieces are damaged.
